Animal profile · Chicken

Chicken: buying, coop care and eggs

The documented route is: buy from Angela, collect the chickens from the fenced area behind her house, bring them to your ranch, and house them in a coop with hay and water in its indoor trough. Egg size, timing and breeding outcomes are not guaranteed.

Answers follow the player workflow. Source type and build are shown; historical notes and single-source leads are not presented as current guarantees.

Start in this order

  1. Complete the purchase with Angela, then collect the chickens from the fenced area behind her house.
  2. Bring them to your ranch and place them in a coop; check the coop link and enclosed fence at its door.
  3. Supply hay and water to the indoor trough. Coop heating equipment is separate from house-decor heaters.
  4. For eggs or quest delivery, check the recorded conditions below; random outcomes have no guaranteed timing.

Get a chicken home

  • Buy chickens from Angela, the chicken seller NPC. After purchase they do not enter your backpack — they appear in the small fenced field behind her house. Grab them manually: carry them home one by one on foot, or load them into a car boot. Community-confirmed · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Chicken coop mission" (DJM, Yakiwi)
  • In every documented case the coop-mission stuck point came from missing the post-purchase prompt; other bugs in this mission cannot be ruled out. Community-confirmed · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Chicken coop mission" (DJM, Yakiwi) · Community discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read)

Housing, feeding & water

  • Chickens live in a coop. The heater and AC must be the coop/barn versions bought from Angela — the house decoration heater/AC sold at City Hall does nothing for coops. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Big Chicken Eggs" (Jennoula, official)
  • Mount the coop heater on the outside of the coop exterior wall. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Big Chicken Eggs" (Jennoula, official)
  • A fenced outdoor roaming area matters: chickens that can roam outside in an enclosed area get the chance to lay large eggs. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "About the chickens" (Jennoula, official)
  • Chickens eat hay — they pick the grains out of hay/straw piles. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Chicken Feed" (Jennoula, official)
  • Two ways to feed: hold hay near the animal to hand-feed (raises the food reserve bar in its info tab), or fill the trough and animals eat by themselves once every morning, covering the whole day. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Food and water reserves" (Mancer, Jennoula)
  • General daily care: only the trough inside the coop needs filling — animals eat and drink inside before leaving in the morning, so outdoor troughs stay optional while the door is open. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "About the chickens" (Jennoula, official)
  • Water is supplied through a trough; hand-feeding does not work for water — the water reserve bar only refills from a trough. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Food and water reserves" (Mancer, Jennoula)
  • For automated water, a water tower alone is not enough — you must sign a water contract with the mayor at City Hall, then the tower refills on its own. Community-confirmed · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Watertower problem" (Akhenatom, Mancer, Jennoula) · Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, shelf scan 03:15–03:45)

Eggs, products & the Gigi route

  • Adult chickens with every need and satisfaction maxed start laying. Egg size (S/M/L) and whether an egg is fertile are RNG; hover an egg to check fertility. Large eggs are the rarest and require maxed needs plus happiness. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Egg Hatching Question" (Jennoula, official; SUwUMaBUwU)
  • Chicken Egg - Small retails at 60C on the Leafy Market shelf. This is a shop purchase price, not what your eggs sell for. Video-observed · 0.8.10.455Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, shelf scan 03:15–03:45)
  • Chicken Breast and Chicken Leg exist as current-build shop items. This confirms that these item records exist; the shelf footage alone does not prove how a chicken is processed, dropped or made available in the current runtime. Video-observed · 0.8.10.455Games Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, shelf scan 03:15–03:45)
  • The Gigi large-egg quest needs large eggs: pet chickens daily to raise their rating and use the Angela heater. Two large eggs are needed before the delivery point appears. Community-confirmed · 0.8.10.xSteam thread on the Gigi egg quest (DJM, Bobthekiller and others)
  • Daily care needs only the trough inside the coop — animals eat and drink there before leaving in the morning (official). What an outdoor area affects is large-egg chance: chickens that roam outside in an enclosed area get the chance to lay large eggs. There is no evidence that the Gigi quest requires an outdoor trough. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "About the chickens" (Jennoula, official)

If a chicken is sick or missing

  • The End of Day report now alerts you to sickness. Chicken illness lasts 4 days before death; arrange treatment promptly. This is not a feeding interval. Official · 0.8.10.858Ranching, Multiplayer & Building Update 0.8.10.858
  • An animal sickness mechanic exists; the heater prevents temperature sickness but cannot cure an already sick animal. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Big Chicken Eggs" (Jennoula, official) · The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! (official Steam announcement)
  • Vet treatment cost is unpublished — nobody in the scanned threads gave a figure. Single-source lead · UnknownCommunity discussion scan archive (local file: community-scan-2026-08-08.md, 90 topics scanned, 44 read)
  • The 0.8.10.842 update adds animal edge-case fixes for barn/coop association, growth-stage state, hunger display, linked counts, repeated turning at doors and a same-frame disappearance case. Official · 0.8.10.8420.8.10.842 update — official Steam announcement
  • Check linking first: walking near the door should show a stock counter like 0/6 over the dark floor area — no counter means the coop is not linked. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread "Hühnerstall Bug" (Kartesk, Jennoula)
  • Before treating a missing chicken as a bug, the official moderator checklist is to verify the coop linked count, whether the door opens into a fully enclosed fence, any daily report notices, and green dots anywhere on the full map. These observations narrow the cause; none alone proves player error or a game bug. Official · 0.8.10.xSteam thread: missing-chicken troubleshooting checklist
